snippet.title: Rift of the NecroDancer: K/DA Music Pack Available Now!
snippet.description:
*NOW AVAILABLE ON STEAM* : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4350150/Rift_of_the_NecroDancer_KDA_Riot_Games_Music_Pack/

You’ve heard of K-Pop, but have you ever heard of “Crypt-Pop”?
These lovely ladies from Rift of the NecroDancer have formed their very own Crypt-Pop group, and they’re here to WOW you with their moves in our newest collaboration with Riot Games and K/DA.

Presenting the Rift of the NecroDancer: K/DA Music Pack! Included in this music pack are:
* POP/STARS
* MORE
* VILLAIN
* THE BADDEST

Enjoy our launch discounts: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/77733/Rift__KDA_Music_Pack/

----
*ABOUT THE GAME*

🎸 *Rift of the NecroDancer*
The NecroDancer's back in an all-new rhythm game! Dragged into a strange new world, Cadence must engage in musical combat with monsters surging through the Rift! Face pulse-pounding Rhythm Rifts where every beat is a battle, all set to an original soundtrack by Danny Baranowsky & friends.
